attributes.$control__paragraph: Seasonal ingredients, local producers, and a dining room open from breakfast through dinner, seven days a week.

attributes.text: Marco trained in Bologna and Lyon before leading kitchens in London and Singapore. He joined The Hotel to build a restaurant that cooks honestly and sources locally. His tasting menu changes every month.
The private dining room seats up to 14 guests and can be reserved for business dinners, celebrations, and special events. Contact us to arrange.
